transforms.name: plural 们
transforms.description: The plural suffix 们 after a person or a pronoun: 朋友们 → 朋友.

transforms.name: erhua 儿
transforms.description: The retroflex suffix 儿 (erhua): 一点儿 → 一点, 玩儿 → 玩.

transforms.name: A-not-A question
transforms.description: A question that repeats a verb or adjective with 不 between: 好不好 → 好, 喜不喜欢 → 喜欢.

transforms.name: A-not-A question (没)
transforms.description: A question that repeats a verb with 没 between: 有没有 → 有, 吃没吃饭 → 吃饭.

transforms.name: reduplication AA
transforms.description: A reduplicated verb (to do a little, to try) or adjective: 看看 → 看, 慢慢 → 慢.

transforms.name: reduplication A一A
transforms.description: A verb reduplicated with 一 between, to do a little: 看一看 → 看, 想一想 → 想.

transforms.name: reduplication A了A
transforms.description: A verb reduplicated with 了 between, done briefly: 看了看 → 看, 点了点头 → 点头.

transforms.name: reduplication A了一A
transforms.description: A verb reduplicated with 了一 between: 看了一看 → 看, 笑了一笑 → 笑.

transforms.name: reduplication AAB
transforms.description: The verb of a verb-object compound reduplicated: 散散步 → 散步, 聊聊天 → 聊天.

transforms.name: reduplication AABB
transforms.description: A disyllabic word reduplicated syllable by syllable: 高高兴兴 → 高兴, 干干净净 → 干净.

transforms.name: reduplication ABAB
transforms.description: A disyllabic verb or state adjective reduplicated whole: 研究研究 → 研究, 雪白雪白 → 雪白.

transforms.name: reduplication A里AB
transforms.description: A disyllabic adjective reduplicated with 里 after its first syllable: 糊里糊涂 → 糊涂.

transforms.name: separated verb-object
transforms.description: A verb-object compound with words between the verb and its object: 洗了个澡 → 洗澡, 生他的气 → 生气.
